text:
maya: quick check — I'm seeing a p99 regression on the new fused-attn on staging. can someone capture a short nsys + torch.profiler trace for the failing batch size? ~30s is enough.

sam: I can take it. which model and seq len?

maya: tiny-attn-1, seq=1024, bs=2. repro command is `pytest -k perf --runstaging` or run the binary `bin/run_perf --model tiny-attn-1 --seq 1024 --bs 2`. set PERF_LOG=1.

sam: ack. I'll run nsys with this and upload: 
```
nsys profile --output=/tmp/1984019123_trace --trace=cuda,osrt --duration=30 
# then convert to .qdrep/.json for chrome
```
I'll also collect a torch.profiler chrome trace with schedule wait=1,warmup=1,active=3.

jin: small reminders: 1) run on the same machine type as staging, 2) scrub any IPs/tokens before sharing (use `scripts/scrub_trace.py`). example: `python scripts/scrub_trace.py /tmp/1984019123_trace.qdrep > /tmp/trace.scrub.qdrep`

maya: when you upload, put under s3://redwood-perf/handoffs/1984019123/ and paste the presigned URL here. perf-bot should pick it up. :+1:

perf-bot: tip — to register artifacts for automated processing: `/perf register s3://redwood-perf/handoffs/1984019123/trace.scrub.qdrep --type=nsys --meta model=tiny-attn-1,seq=1024,bs=2`

alex: if the qdrep is big, gzip before upload. also generate a quick flame snapshot so triage is faster: `python tools/flameplot.py /tmp/trace.scrub.qdrep > /tmp/flame.html`

sam: uploaded (gzipped): s3://redwood-perf/handoffs/1984019123/trace.scrub.qdrep.gz and flame view at s3://redwood-perf/handoffs/1984019123/flame.html. presigned links: <redacted-link-trace> <redacted-link-flame>

maya: perfect — assigning @alex and @jin to triage. if kernel-level regression confirmed we may need a quick canary rollback and an RCA.

alex: I'll diff against last_good/1984018000_trace.qdrep and run the bisect script if needed. ping me in thread when you see the flame output.

maya: thanks all. moved notes into PERF-3221 and added the artifact links. will update after triage.
